content: Kerker barki Agudide peropetage tiditauter merbi arerem mitkar kerkerge a gair tonarge, a keubu e merbim tiditauti taba Weremge. E dali ge Agudide kotor a gesep daratagmi abi neige. E dali ge Agudide abi eraigida narbit gair lugira. Able Werem dali auka bi Agudi zoromira a dali kemerkemer mokakalam Agud tababu, gair lu e erepli taba au sasrimsasrim mirge. Nade e terpeida witira amaidered e temrida taba Bab tuter tag peke kotorge. Able Werem akaida angelaem aukale baida mokakalam abra nei dike aukale angelaem ge abi Agudide ikwari. Ableglam Agudide nole netat tabara angela detagri kega, “Mama nali kara Werem able gergerge ka akaida mara Bab baida.” A Agudide nole netat angelalam detauti kega, “Ka yaka nawer abra Bab a ei wadawer kara Werem.” Nade Agudide maike tabara narbit werem watimarikda ege detauti, “Gair angela gize ko abim isor wairapawem.”
